about: European Molecular Biology Laboratory is an intergovernmental life sciences research organisation with sites across Europe, including its main laboratory in Heidelberg, Germany. EMBL investigates molecular and cellular biology and supports scientific services, technology and training. Its international community connects experimental research with computational approaches to understand biological systems and processes.
name: European Molecular Biology Laboratory (EMBL)

about: Maastricht University is a public research university in the Netherlands. It offers undergraduate, master's and doctoral programmes across health, law, business, science, humanities and social sciences. Its problem-based learning approach encourages discussion and independent study, while its international academic community connects education with interdisciplinary research and questions affecting contemporary society.
name: Maastricht University

about: University of Reading is a public research university in Berkshire, England. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programmes across science, business, humanities and social sciences. Its academic work includes meteorology, agriculture, environmental science and related fields, connecting research and teaching with questions about climate, food systems, society and professional practice.
name: University of Reading

about: The Institute for Bioengineering of Catalonia is a research institute in Barcelona, Spain, working at the intersection of engineering, biology and medicine. IBEC develops bioengineering approaches to understand living systems and address healthcare questions. Its researchers combine experimental methods and technology, supporting collaboration and training across biomedical and engineering disciplines.
name: Institute for Bioengineering of Catalonia (IBEC)

about: King's College London is a public research university and a Russell Group member. Its undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programmes span medicine, law, humanities, psychology, science and other disciplines. With campuses across central London, King's connects academic study and research with healthcare institutions, cultural organisations and wider questions affecting contemporary society.
name: King's College London

about: The University of Melbourne is a public research university in Victoria, Australia, and a member of the Group of Eight. It offers undergraduate, graduate and doctoral education across health, science, engineering, business, law and the arts. Its academic community supports research and collaboration addressing scientific questions and challenges in society.
name: University of Melbourne

about: Wageningen University & Research is a Dutch institution focused on life sciences, agriculture, food and the environment. It combines university education with research addressing sustainable food systems and living environments. Its programmes and projects connect biological, environmental and social perspectives, supporting collaboration with academic institutions, industry and public organisations worldwide.
name: Wageningen University & Research

about: UNICEF is the United Nations Children's Fund, working to support children's rights and wellbeing worldwide. Its activities include education, health, nutrition, protection and emergency response. Alongside field programmes and partnerships, UNICEF provides learning resources through platforms such as Agora, helping staff, partners and learners develop knowledge relevant to its mission.
name: UNICEF

about: Adelaide University is a public university in South Australia, formed through the merger of the University of Adelaide and the University of South Australia. It offers education and research across a broad range of disciplines. Its programmes connect learning with professional practice, industry partnerships and research addressing and global needs.
name: Adelaide University

about: University of Edinburgh is a public research university in Scotland's capital and a member of the Russell Group. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programmes across medicine, science, engineering, humanities and social sciences. Its research community supports collaboration across disciplines, connecting academic inquiry with challenges affecting health, technology and society.
name: The University of Edinburgh

about: Okinawa Institute of Science and Technology is a graduate university in Okinawa, Japan, focused on interdisciplinary scientific research. OIST offers a doctoral programme connecting fields such as biology, neuroscience, physics, chemistry and computing. Its research community works across traditional disciplinary boundaries, combining specialist training with supervised projects and scientific collaboration.
name: Okinawa Institute of Science and Technology (OIST)

about: Australian National University is a public research university in Canberra, Australia. ANU offers undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral education across science, engineering, law, business, humanities and social sciences. Its academic community connects research with policy and public debate, supporting inquiry into scientific questions and issues affecting Australia and the wider world.
name: Australian National University

about: University of São Paulo is a public university in Brazil, maintained by the State of São Paulo. Its schools and research institutes cover science, engineering, health, humanities and social sciences. Researchers can explore postgraduate study and postdoctoral opportunities across its campuses, with requirements published by the relevant academic research units.
name: University of São Paulo

about: Macquarie University is a public research university in Sydney, Australia. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral education across science, engineering, health, business, law, humanities and social sciences. Its community connects teaching with interdisciplinary research, professional partnerships and practical applications, supporting inquiry into questions affecting people, technology, the environment and society.
name: Macquarie University

about: University of Warwick is a public research university near Coventry, England, and a Russell Group member. It offers undergraduate, master's and doctoral programmes across science, engineering, business, economics, humanities and social sciences. Its campus-based academic community connects teaching with research, professional development and collaboration with industry and international university partners.
name: University of Warwick
University of Basel
about: The University of Basel is Switzerland's oldest university, with leading research groups in nanoscience, chemistry, physics, biomedical sciences and life sciences. It is closely linked to the Basel life-science industry cluster and hosts the Swiss Nanoscience Institute on its campus. Doctoral positions are salaried in line with Swiss university standards, and international candidates form a large share of the research community. Open positions and doctoral programmes are advertised through the university's job portal.

Heriot-Watt University is a public university with campuses in Scotland, Dubai and Malaysia. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral education in fields including engineering, computing, physical sciences, business and design. Its teaching and research emphasise practical applications, connecting expertise with industry and challenges in technology, sustainability and the wider economy.
name: Heriot-Watt University

about: The University of Lausanne is a public research university in Switzerland, located near Lake Geneva. UNIL offers undergraduate, master's and doctoral programmes across medicine, life sciences, law, business, humanities and social sciences. Its academic work supports research across disciplines, connecting education with questions in health, society, culture and the environment.
name: University of Lausanne

about: Griffith University is a public university in Queensland, Australia, with campuses serving Brisbane and the Gold Coast. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate and research degrees across health, science, engineering, business, education and the arts. Its teaching and research connect knowledge with professional practice, regional communities and wider environmental and societal questions.
name: Griffith University

about: University of Strathclyde is a public research university in Glasgow, Scotland. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programmes across engineering, science, business, humanities and social sciences. Its approach connects academic learning with practical research and industry collaboration, supporting work in areas such as energy, advanced manufacturing, health and digital technology.
name: University of Strathclyde

about: The Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council supports research and postgraduate training in the United Kingdom. Part of UK Research and Innovation, EPSRC funds work in engineering, mathematics, computing and physical sciences. Its programmes support researchers and infrastructure, connecting fundamental discoveries with applications in technology, industry and wider societal challenges.
name: Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council (EPSRC)

about: Newcastle University is a public research university in Newcastle upon Tyne, England, and a member of the Russell Group. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programmes across medicine, engineering, science, business, humanities and social sciences. Its community connects education and research with regional partnerships, international collaboration and questions affecting society.
name: Newcastle University

about: Royal Academy of Engineering is the United Kingdom's national academy for engineering. It supports engineering research, education, skills and entrepreneurship through fellowships, grants and other programmes. Its activities connect engineers with industry, policymakers and communities, helping develop knowledge and practical solutions to challenges facing the engineering profession and wider society.
name: Royal Academy of Engineering

about: Cranfield University is a specialist postgraduate university in England focused on technology and management. It offers master's programmes and doctoral research in areas including aerospace, manufacturing, transport, energy and business. Its research facilities and industry partnerships support practical investigations, connecting advanced study with professional applications and challenges across different sectors.
name: Cranfield University

about: Research Grants Council is an advisory body on research funding under Hong Kong's University Grants Committee. RGC supports academic research through competitive funding schemes and administers the Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme. Its activities help develop research capacity and doctoral education, with eligibility and application requirements set by individual programmes.
name: Research Grants Council of Hong Kong

about: TU Delft is a public technical university in Delft, the Netherlands. It offers undergraduate, master's and doctoral education across engineering, architecture, design and applied sciences. Its research connects technical knowledge with practical challenges, including energy, mobility, infrastructure and sustainability, through collaboration with industry, public organisations and international academic institutions worldwide.
name: TU Delft

about: University of Chicago is a private research university in Chicago, Illinois, United States. It offers undergraduate, graduate and professional education across science, humanities, social sciences, business, law and medicine. Its academic community supports analytical inquiry and interdisciplinary research, connecting scholarship with questions in culture, public policy, health and scientific discovery.
name: University of Chicago

about: Massachusetts Institute of Technology is a private research university in Cambridge, Massachusetts, United States. MIT offers undergraduate, graduate and doctoral education in science, engineering, computing, architecture, management and other fields. Its research community connects fundamental inquiry with practical applications, supporting collaboration across disciplines and work on technological and societal challenges.
name: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT)

about: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University is a public research university in Taiwan, formed in 2021 through a university merger. NYCU offers undergraduate, graduate and doctoral study in fields including engineering, computing, science and biomedicine. Its campuses and research groups connect education with technological development, healthcare and collaboration across disciplines.
name: National Yang Ming Chiao Tung University (NYCU)

about: Royal College of Art is a postgraduate university of art and design in London, England. RCA offers master's and research programmes across creative disciplines, including design, fine art and architecture. Its academic community combines studio practice with critical inquiry and research, supporting experimentation, collaboration and the development of creative approaches.
name: Royal College of Art

about: Human Technopole is a life sciences research institute in Milan, Italy. Its work brings together disciplines such as genomics, computational biology and biomedical research to investigate human health and disease. The institute supports collaboration and research infrastructure, connecting experimental methods with data analysis and opportunities for scientific training and development.
name: Human Technopole

about: Lancaster University is a public research university in northwest England. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programmes across science, technology, business, humanities and social sciences. Its research includes computing, communications, cybersecurity and artificial intelligence, while its collegiate community supports interdisciplinary work and partnerships with industry, public organisations and international institutions.
name: Lancaster University

about: Max Planck Society is a German research organisation operating institutes across the natural sciences, life sciences, social sciences and humanities. Its institutes focus on fundamental research and scientific discovery. International researchers collaborate through specialist projects, doctoral training and research networks, contributing to knowledge across a broad range of academic disciplines.
name: Max Planck Society

about: The International Centre for Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology is an international research organisation with centres in Trieste, New Delhi and Cape Town. ICGEB conducts life sciences research and supports scientific training and cooperation. Its activities connect biotechnology, molecular biology and related disciplines with questions in health, agriculture and scientific development.
name: International Centre for Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology (ICGEB)

about: The Laboratory for Multiscale Geomechanics is associated with civil engineering research at McMaster University in Canada. Its research context includes understanding geomaterials and their behaviour through computational and multiscale approaches. Prospective researchers should consult McMaster's official laboratory and faculty information for current projects, supervision arrangements and available postgraduate research opportunities.
name: McMaster University - Laboratory for Multiscale Geomechanics

about: The Royal Society is the United Kingdom's national academy of sciences, founded in 1660. It supports scientific research through fellowships, grants, publications and policy work. Its activities bring researchers together to exchange ideas and share evidence, while promoting scientific understanding and international collaboration across disciplines and questions affecting wider society.
name: Royal Society

about: Norwegian University of Science and Technology is a public research university based primarily in Trondheim, Norway. NTNU offers education and doctoral research across engineering, technology, natural sciences, health, humanities and social sciences. Its academic work combines scientific foundations with applied research, supporting collaboration on challenges in industry, sustainability and society.
name: Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU)

about: University of Exeter is a public research university in Devon and Cornwall, England, and a member of the Russell Group. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral study across science, health, business, humanities and social sciences. Its research includes climate and environmental questions, connecting academic expertise with regional and international partnerships.
name: University of Exeter

about: Institute for AI Policy and Strategy is a research organisation focused on artificial intelligence governance and policy. IAPS examines how institutions can respond to the opportunities and challenges associated with advanced AI. Its research and professional development activities connect technical understanding with policy analysis, supporting informed discussion about AI governance.
name: Institute for AI Policy and Strategy

about: The Rhodes Trust administers the Rhodes Scholarships for postgraduate study at the University of Oxford. Based in Oxford, the Trust supports eligible scholars selected through its scholarship constituencies and programmes. Its work combines financial support with a scholarly community, encouraging academic development, leadership and engagement with questions affecting society internationally.
name: Rhodes Trust

about: University of Twente is a public university in Enschede, the Netherlands. It offers undergraduate, master's and doctoral programmes combining engineering, technology and social sciences. Its research connects technical innovation with human and societal needs, including work in digital systems, health and sustainability, supported by collaboration with industry and academic partners.
name: University of Twente

about: University of the West of England, Bristol, is a public university in southwest England. UWE Bristol offers undergraduate, postgraduate and research degrees across engineering, computing, business, health, education and creative fields. Its teaching and research connect academic learning with professional practice, applied questions and partnerships with employers and regional communities.
name: University of the West of England (UWE Bristol)

about: Herzog August Bibliothek is a research library in Wolfenbüttel, Germany, with collections relevant to medieval and early modern history. It supports scholarly research through its holdings, academic activities and fellowship opportunities. Researchers use manuscripts, books and other historical materials to investigate questions in intellectual history, literature, religion and cultural studies.
name: Herzog August Bibliothek

about: Isaac Newton Institute for Mathematical Sciences is a research institute at the University of Cambridge, England. It hosts thematic programmes bringing mathematicians and related researchers together for extended collaboration. Its workshops and scientific activities support the exchange of ideas, connecting mathematical research with developments across science, technology and other disciplines.
name: Isaac Newton Institute for Mathematical Sciences

about: The Cologne Graduate School of Ageing Research provides structured doctoral training in Germany focused on the biology of ageing. It connects partner universities and research institutes in Cologne. Doctoral researchers investigate mechanisms related to ageing and health through supervised projects, scientific training and collaboration across an international biomedical research community.
name: Cologne Graduate School of Ageing Research (CGA)

about: São Paulo Research Foundation, known as FAPESP, is a public funding agency supporting research in Brazil's São Paulo state. It awards grants and fellowships across academic disciplines, including support for postgraduate researchers. Its programmes help develop scientific knowledge and research capacity, with eligibility and funding conditions defined by each scheme.
name: São Paulo Research Foundation (FAPESP)

about: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology is a graduate research university in Thuwal, Saudi Arabia. KAUST offers master's and doctoral education in science and engineering. Its research community investigates topics including computing, energy, materials, bioscience and the environment, using specialist facilities and collaborative projects to connect research with applications.
name: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST)

about: University of Oxford is a collegiate research university in Oxford, England. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral education across medicine, science, engineering, humanities and social sciences. Its departments, colleges and research institutes support scholarship and international collaboration, providing opportunities for students and researchers to investigate questions across many academic fields.
name: University of Oxford

about: The Water4All Partnership is a European research and innovation partnership focused on water security. It connects participating funders and organisations to support research addressing water-related challenges. Its activities include collaborative funding calls and knowledge exchange, helping link scientific research with approaches to sustainable water management, environmental protection and societal needs.
name: Water4All Partnership

about: Karlsruhe Institute of Technology is a German institution combining a research university with a national research centre. KIT offers undergraduate, master's and doctoral education in science, engineering and related subjects. Its research connects knowledge with applications in energy, mobility, information technology and materials through collaboration across disciplines and with industry.
name: Karlsruhe Institute of Technology

about: Vanderbilt University is a private research university in Nashville, Tennessee, United States. It offers undergraduate, graduate and professional education across arts, sciences, engineering, education, law, medicine and other fields. Its community supports interdisciplinary research and teaching, connecting university scholarship with questions in health, technology, society and the broader public sphere.
name: Vanderbilt University

about: RAINZ is the EPSRC Centre for Doctoral Training in Robotics and AI for Net Zero, bringing together Manchester, Glasgow and Oxford universities. Its doctoral programme develops robotics and artificial intelligence for managing critical energy infrastructure. Researchers combine training with collaborative projects addressing inspection, maintenance and the transition toward net zero.
name: RAINZ CDT

about: University of Otago is a public research university based in Dunedin, New Zealand. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programmes across health sciences, science, business and the humanities. Its academic work connects education with research in areas including medicine and public health, supporting collaboration with professional organisations and wider communities.
name: University of Otago

about: The Rotary Yoneyama Memorial Foundation is a Japanese scholarship organisation supporting international students studying in Japan. Its programmes provide financial assistance to eligible scholars and connect them with Rotary communities. The foundation promotes academic development and intercultural understanding, with scholarship categories, application procedures and support levels determined by each programme.
name: Rotary Yoneyama Memorial Foundation

about: CEITEC at Masaryk University is a research centre in Brno, Czech Republic, within the Central European Institute of Technology network. Its work focuses on life sciences and interdisciplinary research, supported by specialist facilities. Researchers connect experimental methods with scientific analysis, contributing to understanding biological systems and collaboration across academic disciplines.
name: Masaryk University - CEITEC

about: Karolinska Institutet is a medical university in Stockholm, Sweden. It offers education and research in medicine, health sciences and related fields, including doctoral training. Its researchers investigate human health and disease through experimental, clinical and public health approaches. The university's Nobel Assembly awards the Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine.
name: Karolinska Institutet

about: KU Leuven is a research university in Belgium with origins dating to 1425. It offers undergraduate, master's and doctoral programmes across science, engineering, medicine, humanities and social sciences. Its academic community connects teaching with research and international collaboration, supporting students and researchers pursuing questions across a broad range of disciplines.
name: KU Leuven

about: Belgium's Federal Public Service Foreign Affairs, Foreign Trade and Development Cooperation manages the country's international relations and development cooperation. Its activities include support for multilateral organisations and programmes. Through initiatives such as the Junior Professional Officer programme, it contributes to opportunities and cooperation, with eligibility depending on each recruitment scheme.
name: Belgian FPS Foreign Affairs

about: Earlham Institute is a life sciences research institute based at Norwich Research Park in England. Its research focuses on genomics and computational biology, using experimental and analytical approaches to understand living systems. The institute supports scientific collaboration, specialist technology and researcher training, connecting biological data with questions across diverse organisms.
name: Earlham Institute

about: San Diego State University is a public research university in California and part of the California State University system. SDSU offers undergraduate, graduate and doctoral programmes across science, engineering, business, education, health, arts and social sciences. Its teaching and research connect work with regional communities, professional practice and international collaboration.
name: San Diego State University

about: Université PSL is a research university in Paris, France, bringing together institutions including École normale supérieure and Paris Dauphine. It offers education and research across science, engineering, humanities, social sciences and the arts. Its community supports interdisciplinary inquiry and collaboration, connecting specialist expertise with scientific discovery and broader cultural questions.
name: Université PSL

about: UK Government supports international postgraduate study through Chevening Scholarships, funded by the Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office and partner organisations. These awards enable eligible applicants to undertake study at UK universities. Selection, funding and application conditions depend on the scholarship cycle, supporting development and connections within an international alumni network.
name: UK Government

about: Northumbria University is a public university in Newcastle upon Tyne, England. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programmes across computing, engineering, business, health, law and creative disciplines. Its research and teaching connect academic study with applied questions, supporting professional development and collaboration with industry, public organisations and international academic partners.
name: Northumbria University

about: University of Waterloo is a public research university in Ontario, Canada. It offers undergraduate, graduate and doctoral programmes across engineering, mathematics, science, business-related fields, arts and health. Its cooperative education model connects study with work experience, while research groups investigate topics ranging from digital technologies to infrastructure and environmental challenges.
name: University of Waterloo

about: The University of Auckland is a public research university in Auckland, New Zealand. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral education across science, engineering, medicine, business, law, education and the arts. Its academic community supports research across disciplines, connecting teaching and scholarship with professional practice, international partnerships and questions affecting society.
name: University of Auckland

about: Berlin Graduate School of Ancient Studies provides structured doctoral education in Germany through partner universities and research institutions. BerGSAS supports study of the ancient world across fields including archaeology, history, languages and related disciplines. Its programmes combine supervised research with training, encouraging collaboration and exchange within an international scholarly community.
name: Berlin Graduate School of Ancient Studies

about: The Ghedini Lab at Monash University in Melbourne, Australia, studies community ecology and evolution. Its research uses marine phytoplankton to investigate how species traits, metabolism and interactions shape ecological communities. The group combines laboratory experiments with ecological and physiological approaches, exploring questions about community organisation, environmental change and ecosystem functioning.
name: Monash University - Ghedini Lab

about: Nanyang Technological University is a research university in Singapore. NTU offers undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral education across engineering, science, business, humanities and social sciences. Its work includes interdisciplinary research and collaboration with external partners, connecting scientific and technological questions with applications in areas such as sustainability, health and digital systems.
name: Nanyang Technological University (NTU)

about: Örebro University is a public university in Örebro, Sweden. It offers undergraduate, master's and doctoral education across medicine, health, technology, natural sciences, humanities and social sciences. Its academic community supports interdisciplinary research and teaching, connecting scientific inquiry with practical questions through collaboration with public organisations, industry and international academic partners.
name: Örebro University

about: University College London is a public research university in London, England, and a member of the Russell Group. UCL offers undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral education across science, engineering, medicine, law, humanities and social sciences. Its multidisciplinary research community connects academic work with questions in health, technology, culture and contemporary society.
name: University College London

about: EMBO, the European Molecular Biology Organization, supports life sciences researchers through fellowships, training, scientific meetings and professional networks. Its programmes help researchers develop careers and exchange knowledge across institutions and countries. EMBO also publishes scientific research, connecting the international life sciences community with resources for collaboration, learning and scholarly communication.
name: EMBO (European Molecular Biology Organization)
Chalmers University of Technology
about: Chalmers University of Technology is a leading Swedish technical university with strengths in quantum technology, machine learning, and electrical engineering.

Clarkson University is a private university in Potsdam, New York, United States. It offers undergraduate, graduate and research programmes in engineering, science, business and related fields. Its academic approach combines technical and professional education with research, supporting students interested in practical problem solving, interdisciplinary projects and collaboration with industry partners.
name: Clarkson University

about: Massey University is a public university in New Zealand with campuses in Auckland, Palmerston North and Wellington. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral education across business, science, health, humanities and creative subjects. Its academic programmes include distance learning, while research and professional partnerships connect study with communities and industry applications.
name: Massey University

about: Auckland University of Technology is a public university in Auckland, New Zealand. AUT offers undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programmes across health, engineering, computing, business, education and creative disciplines. Its teaching and research connect knowledge with professional practice and applied questions, supported by collaboration with industry, communities and international academic partners.
name: Auckland University of Technology (AUT)
Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam
about: Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam is a research university in the Netherlands with strengths in physics, molecular sciences, and interdisciplinary research. Its Department of Physics and Astronomy hosts the NWO-XL consortium on human-made molecular machines.

name: Institute of Molecular and Clinical Ophthalmology Basel (IOB)
about: The Institute of Molecular and Clinical Ophthalmology Basel (IOB) is a research institute dedicated to translational neuroscience and vision research.

Natural Environment Research Council supports environmental science research and training in the United Kingdom. Part of UK Research and Innovation, NERC funds work on the atmosphere, oceans, land, biodiversity and climate. Its programmes support infrastructure and researchers, helping develop evidence about environmental change and the relationship between people and nature.
name: Natural Environment Research Council (NERC)

about: University of Glasgow is a public research university in Scotland, founded in 1451, and a Russell Group member. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral education across medicine, science, engineering, business, humanities and social sciences. Its community connects research and teaching with international partnerships and questions affecting health, society and technology.
name: University of Glasgow

about: Peking University is a public research university in Beijing, China. It offers undergraduate, master's and doctoral education across the sciences, humanities, social sciences, medicine and other fields. Its institutions include the Yenching Academy, while research groups and international partnerships provide opportunities to investigate disciplinary questions and broader issues in society.
name: Peking University

about: The Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK manages scholarship and fellowship programmes guided by international development objectives. Its awards support eligible applicants from Commonwealth countries to study or undertake professional development. Funding and selection depend on each scheme, with programmes intended to develop knowledge and skills relevant to development priorities.
name: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK

about: The University of Sussex is a public research university near Brighton, England. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programmes across science, engineering, business, humanities and social sciences. Its academic work includes interdisciplinary research and international collaboration, connecting education with questions about social change, environmental challenges, human behaviour and scientific discovery.
name: University of Sussex

about: The Gates Cambridge Trust administers Gates Cambridge Scholarships for eligible international applicants pursuing postgraduate study at the University of Cambridge. Its awards provide financial support under programme-specific conditions. The Trust also supports a community of scholars and alumni, connecting academic work with leadership development and engagement with challenges affecting others.
name: Gates Cambridge Trust

about: Uppsala University is a comprehensive research university in Uppsala, Sweden, and the oldest university in the Nordic countries. Its research and education span science, medicine, technology, humanities and social sciences. Doctoral students are employed as paid researchers with monthly salaries across its departments.
name: Uppsala University

about: The ETH AI Center is ETH Zurich's hub for artificial intelligence research, education and innovation. It brings together researchers across machine learning, robotics, computer vision and AI applications, and runs doctoral fellowship programmes that connect doctoral students across departments.
name: ETH AI Center

about: The Francis Crick Institute is a biomedical discovery institute in London, a partnership between the Medical Research Council, Cancer Research UK and Wellcome. Its doctoral students register with partner universities while working inside the Crick's research groups, which span cancer, immunology, neuroscience and infection biology.
name: The Francis Crick Institute

about: Campus France is the French national agency for international higher education and mobility, operating under the Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs. It administers France's major international scholarship programmes, including the France Excellence Eiffel scholarship, and guides international students through admission to French universities and grandes ecoles.
name: Campus France

about: Türkiye Scholarships (Türkiye Bursları) is the Turkish government's flagship scholarship programme, run by the Presidency for Turks Abroad and Related Communities (YTB). It provides fully funded study at all levels - including university placement, monthly stipend, accommodation, health insurance and flights - for international students.
name: Türkiye Scholarships (YTB)

about: The Swedish Institute is a government agency building relationships with other countries through scholarship programmes, cultural exchange and public diplomacy. Its flagship SISGP scholarship funds master's study in Sweden for professionals from eligible countries, covering tuition and living costs.
name: Swedish Institute

about: EPFL (Ecole Polytechnique Federale de Lausanne) is one of Europe's leading technical universities on the Lake Geneva shore. Its doctoral programs - including the EDBB in biotechnology and bioengineering - employ doctoral candidates on Swiss contracts and concentrate research across engineering, life sciences and physical sciences.
name: EPFL

about: The University of Hong Kong is Hong Kong's oldest university and one of Asia's leading research institutions. Its Graduate School administers research postgraduate admissions and top-tier doctoral schemes such as the Presidential PhD Scholar Programme.
name: The University of Hong Kong

about: The University of Oslo is Norway's oldest and largest university. Doctoral researchers are employed on salaried contracts with full social benefits, and its Natural History Museum hosts nationally significant biodiversity and molecular research groups.
name: University of Oslo

about: The International Max Planck Research School for Chemistry and Physics of Quantum Materials (IMPRS-CPQM) is a tri-institutional graduate school of the Max Planck Institute for Chemical Physics of Solids, Technische Universitaet Dresden and the University of St Andrews, offering 20+ funded doctoral projects in condensed matter physics and solid-state chemistry.
name: IMPRS-CPQM (Max Planck / TU Dresden / St Andrews)

about: Tempus Public Foundation is a Hungarian public organisation that manages international education and mobility programmes on behalf of the Hungarian government. It operates the Stipendium Hungaricum scholarship programme, which brings thousands of international students to Hungarian universities every year with tuition-free study, monthly stipends and housing support. The foundation also serves as the national agency for European cooperation programmes in education and training and coordinates bilateral scholarship agreements with partner countries. Applicants normally meet Tempus through the Stipendium Hungaricum portal, the sending partners' nomination process and the university admission rounds that follow.
name: Tempus Public Foundation

about: The National Institute for International Education (NIIED) is a Korean government agency under the Ministry of Education that manages international student mobility and national scholarship programmes. Through the Study in Korea platform it administers the Global Korea Scholarship (GKS), the flagship fully-funded award covering tuition, a monthly allowance, airfare and a compulsory Korean language year. NIIED coordinates both the embassy track and the university track of GKS, working with designated universities across South Korea. Annual calls, guidelines and quota tables are published on its official portals, and applicants apply either through Korean embassies or directly to partner universities.
name: National Institute for International Education (NIIED) / Study in Korea

about: Study in NL is the official national platform for international students considering study in the Netherlands, operated with support from the Dutch Ministry of Education, Culture and Science (OCW) and Nuffic, the Dutch organisation for internationalisation in education. The site explains the NL Scholarship, the successor to the Holland Scholarship, along with tuition fee levels, visa procedures, insurance and student life. Its scholarship finder lists funding offered by Dutch universities, ministries and public bodies in one searchable place. Prospective bachelor's and master's students use it to compare deadlines and funding before applying to Dutch institutions.
name: Study in NL (Dutch Ministry of OCW)

about: The Islamic Development Bank is a multilateral development bank headquartered in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, serving its 57 member countries and Muslim communities worldwide. Its scholarship programmes, including the IsDB Merit Scholarship, the Science and Technology programme and awards for least developed member countries, have supported tens of thousands of students in STEM, medicine and development-related fields. Awards typically cover tuition fees, a monthly living allowance, health insurance and thesis or research support for the duration of study. Calls for applications are announced programme-wise on the IsDB scholarship portal, and applications are submitted online through the bank's scholarship portal.
name: Islamic Development Bank (IsDB)

about: UMCG is one of the largest university medical centres in the Netherlands and the academic hospital of the University of Groningen. It combines patient care with biomedical research and graduate education, organised around research institutes covering neuroscience, oncology, ageing, regenerative medicine and population health. The centre employs PhD candidates and postdocs on salaried contracts under the Dutch collective agreement for university medical centres (CAO-UMC). Research and clinical vacancies, including physician-researcher tracks and technical R&D roles, are published on its recruitment portal werkenbijumcg.nl.
name: University Medical Center Groningen (UMCG)

about: Leiden University, founded in 1575, is the oldest university in the Netherlands and a member of the League of European Research Universities (LERU). Its seven faculties in Leiden and The Hague cover humanities, law, social and behavioural sciences, medicine, science, archaeology and governance. Doctoral candidates at Leiden are salaried employees under the CAO-NU collective agreement rather than fee-paying students, which makes its PhD positions fully funded by design. All academic vacancies, including PhD and postdoctoral roles, are advertised on the university's dedicated careers portal.
name: Leiden University

about: Utrecht University is a leading Dutch research university, consistently ranked among the top institutions in Europe. Its research and teaching span four faculties and a broad range of strategic themes, including sustainability, dynamics of youth, institutions for open societies and life sciences. PhD candidates and postdocs in the Netherlands are salaried staff members with full employment benefits under the CAO-NU collective agreement, so advertised positions are fully funded. Academic and support vacancies are published on the university's working-at portal, with clear deadlines and application instructions per position.
name: Utrecht University

about: The University of Copenhagen is Denmark's oldest and largest research university, founded in 1479. Its six faculties cover health and medical sciences, humanities, law, science, social sciences and theology, and the university consistently ranks among the leading research institutions in Europe. Doctoral training is organised through the university's graduate schools, where salaried PhD positions and externally funded doctoral networks, including Marie Sklodowska-Curie actions, are advertised on the employment portal. A large share of the academic community is international, and English is the working language in most research environments.
name: University of Copenhagen

about: Stockholm University is a public research university in the Swedish capital with roughly 30,000 students and a strong research profile in the natural sciences, psychology, humanities, law and social sciences. Many of its departments collaborate with national research institutes located on the same campus areas, including the neighbouring Science for Life Laboratory environment. Doctoral students in Sweden are employed on paid contracts with collective-agreement salaries and full social benefits. PhD and postdoctoral vacancies are recruited through the national Varbi system used by Swedish universities.
name: Stockholm University

about: Lund University, founded in 1666, is one of Sweden's largest and most international universities and a member of the League of European Research Universities. Its faculties cover engineering, science, medicine, economics, humanities, social sciences, law and the performing arts, and the nearby Copenhagen area makes the Oresund region a strong research hub. Doctoral students are salaried employees under Swedish collective agreements, and postdoctoral fellowships are advertised through the university's Varbi recruitment portal. The university ranks among the top 100 research universities worldwide in major rankings.
name: Lund University

about: The University of Amsterdam (UvA) is the largest university in the Netherlands and one of Europe's leading research institutions. Its seven faculties span the humanities, social and behavioural sciences, economics and business, law, science, medicine in cooperation with Amsterdam UMC, and dentistry. PhD candidates at the UvA are employed on salaried contracts under the CAO-NU collective agreement, making doctoral research here fully funded. Academic vacancies and doctoral positions are published on the university's academic careers portal with detailed role profiles and application requirements.
name: University of Amsterdam

about: Amsterdam UMC is the combined academic medical centre of the University of Amsterdam and Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam, operating from AMC and VUmc campuses. It is one of the largest biomedical research institutions in the Netherlands, with research programmes spanning infectious diseases, oncology, cardiovascular science, epidemiology, public health and health data science. The centre employs PhD candidates and postdocs on salaried contracts under the CAO-UMC collective agreement. Research vacancies are published on the werkenbij.amsterdamumc.org portal, and many doctoral projects are embedded in national and European research consortia.
name: Amsterdam UMC

about: Maynooth University, near Dublin, is Ireland's fastest-growing university and one of its oldest seated institutions, tracing its origins to 1795. It combines a strong research profile in the sciences, social sciences, humanities, engineering and education with close student-faculty ratios. The university hosts funded research centres across climate, smart technologies, social science and health, and its postdoctoral researchers work on nationally and internationally funded projects, including EU Horizon and Science Foundation Ireland programmes. Research vacancies are published through the university's Corehr recruitment portal with full job specifications.
name: Maynooth University

about: Liverpool John Moores University is a large civic university in Liverpool, England, formed in 1992 from institutions dating back to 1823. It combines applied research with industry-linked teaching across science, engineering, health, business and the arts, and holds a strong record in environmental and ecological research, including peatland and wetland systems. LJMU research centres work with UKRI, Innovate UK and international partners on applied projects, and research staff positions are advertised on the university's dedicated jobs portal with clear vacancy specifications and closing dates.
name: Liverpool John Moores University

about: The University of Southampton is a Russell Group research university on England's south coast, ranking among the UK's top engineering, ocean and earth science institutions. It hosts the National Oceanography Centre partnership, world-leading maritime robotics groups and one of the UK's largest doctorate-training portfolios, including Marie Sklodowska-Curie doctoral networks. Southampton research spans engineering, environmental and marine sciences, electronics, health and the humanities, with doctoral candidates recruited through the university's eRecruitment portal for funded projects across its faculties and research institutes.
name: University of Southampton

about: Bath Spa University is a university in Bath, England, rooted in institutions dating back to 1852, with campuses including Newton Park and Corsham Court. It offers doctoral training across education, management and business, creative arts, humanities and social sciences, and is an active partner in the ESRC South West Doctoral Training Partnership (SWDTP) through which funded studentships are offered with partner universities. Research degrees at Bath Spa combine supervision by research-active staff with training in methods and professional development, and applications run through the university's research degrees admissions route.
name: Bath Spa University

about: The Technical University of Denmark (DTU) is one of Europe's leading technical universities, based north of Copenhagen. It ranks among the world's best for engineering and hosts research across energy, computing, biotechnology, robotics and management engineering, including DTU Entrepreneurship as a dedicated hub for technology-based innovation studies. Doctoral candidates at DTU are salaried researchers under the Danish collective agreement, recruited through the university's online recruitment system, and DTU participates extensively in EU Horizon and Nordic research programmes with strong industry collaboration.
name: Technical University of Denmark (DTU)

about: The London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine (LSHTM) is a world-leading research university for public and global health, consistently ranked at the top of its field internationally. Its research spans epidemiology, infectious disease, immunology, health economics and health policy, with major multi-country trial and training programmes funded by Wellcome, UKRI and the global health agencies. LSHTM runs structured, fully funded doctoral training programmes such as CREATE for global health research, and recruits fellows and research staff through its online recruitment portal.
name: London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine (LSHTM)

about: Radboudumc is the academic medical centre of Nijmegen, connected to Radboud University. It combines specialised patient care, research and education with a focus on prevention and personalised medicine, and hosts one of the Netherlands' leading clinical research environments. Doctoral researchers work in multidisciplinary teams spanning clinical departments, the Radboud Institute for Health Sciences and technology partners.
name: Radboudumc

about: The University of Essex is a public research university in Colchester, England, with additional campuses in Southend and Loughton. Its Department of Government is ranked among the strongest in the UK, and the university is internationally known for research on conflict, human rights, democracy and the social sciences. Doctoral researchers join an international academic community with dedicated graduate training and funding support.
name: University of Essex

about: The French National Centre for Scientific Research (CNRS) is one of the world's largest fundamental research organisations, covering all fields of knowledge. Its Laboratoire Jacques-Louis Lions (UMR 7598), run jointly with Sorbonne Universite in Paris, is a leading centre for applied mathematics, analysis and partial differential equations. Researchers work within project teams with access to national research infrastructures and international collaborations.
name: CNRS

about: UMC Utrecht is the university medical centre of Utrecht, affiliated with Utrecht University. It combines specialised patient care with leading research programmes in life sciences and health, and trains the next generation of medical and biomedical researchers. Doctoral researchers work in multidisciplinary teams across clinical departments and research institutes, including the Wilhelmina Children's Hospital.
name: UMC Utrecht
